conviction_note: The +19.02% print reaction the baseline records for 2025-09-04 was a buyback announcement and a results release landing one day apart; this year the same $10m buyback was announced on 2026-09-03 but the results are six sessions later, the buyback leg has already paid (+21.5% on 2,789,500 shares against a ~7,300-share 20-day average) and the stock is +93.4% in five sessions - so the catalyst that produced the historical up-print has already fired before this print, and the two genuine results releases since then were met with -4.58% and 0.0%; sized well inside the 142% realised vol because the sign here is far from certain.

findings.finding: The September-2025 template has been repeated but unbundled: on 2025-09-03 YQ announced a $10m repurchase and printed Q2 results on 2025-09-04, and the baseline records that combined event as +19.02%; in 2026 the identical $10m repurchase was approved effective 2026-09-03 but the results 6-K is six sessions later, and the buyback leg alone has already produced +21.5% on 2026-09-03 and +93.4% over five sessions, taking the market cap from the $24.75m recorded in event.json to roughly $41m at the 2026-09-08 close of 3.79 against the ~$51m of cash the buyback release was being read against.

findings.why_not_priced: The company has no consensus at all (event.json n_estimates N/A, consensus null), no analyst coverage, and a 7.51m-share float on ~$17k of normal daily liquidity, so nothing about the print itself is in a model anywhere. What is priced, violently, is the buyback and the cash-shell discount: the discount to net cash has gone from about 51% on 2026-09-03 to about 20% by 2026-09-08, so the specific valuation argument that was being posted as the reason to buy is roughly 60% consumed before the results even arrive. If the print itself were the driver, the volume spike would be sitting on 2026-09-09 rather than on 2026-09-03.

findings.finding: The 'CEO is buying' stream that ran alongside the squeeze is twelve open-market purchases between 2026-07-20 and 2026-09-04 that together take Liu Chang from 35,149 to 113,070 shares - about 78,000 shares for roughly $170,000, i.e. under 0.7% of the market cap and about 1% of the 7.51m float, in individual tickets of $2,079 to $23,788 - and it stopped on 2026-09-04.

findings.why_not_priced: Each individual Form 4 generated its own bullish headline - twelve of them, all tagged Bullish on the social feed, one roughly every five sessions - so the market has received twelve separate insider-buying signals and no aggregate. Totalled, it is a sub-$200k drip that is immaterial to a $25-41m company and is roughly the size of two normal days of dollar volume; the drumbeat was a headline generator, not a stake build. Nobody sums a Form 4 series, which is exactly why the corpus contains the twelve announcements and no total.

baseline_tension: It cuts hard against the run-up rather than reading direction out of it: the baseline hands me a 93.4% five-day move and an unusable history, and my case is that the specific catalyst behind that move (the 2026-09-03 buyback 6-K, 600x normal volume) is a separate, already-consumed event, that the net-cash discount underwriting it has narrowed from ~51% to ~20%, and that the company's two most recent genuine results prints - including one showing +359% revenue growth - went -4.58% and 0.0%.
corpus_limits: No contaminated documents - tripwires is null in all four YQ snapshots. Not in the capture: any option chain (options.status empty_chain, so no implied move and no skew); the 13D/A body, which is the largest single unknown and is why my band on this name is enormous; any 6-K or 20-F text at all (both stored bodies are stocktwits dumps, so every company figure I use - CNY 99.5m, +359%, $51m cash, $10m buyback, 7.51m float - reaches me second-hand through social copy citing a primary source rather than from the primary source, which is a real weakness and the reason two of three findings are marked body_available false); quote.json's last bar (2026-09-08) is a mid-session snapshot at 11:08 ET showing 3.4502 on 162,595 shares, not the 3.79 close the baseline reports, so the final day's action is known only through the baseline.
